stem.en: What happens to a pulse's frequency spectrum as the pulse is made shorter in time?
stem.et: Mis juhtub impulsi sagedusspektriga, kui impulssi ajas lühemaks teha?

label.en: It becomes broader — short in time means wide in frequency
label.et: See muutub laiemaks — ajas lühike tähendab sageduses laia

label.en: It becomes narrower, in step with the pulse
It is unchanged, since the spectrum carries less detail than the waveform
label.et: See ei muutu, sest spekter kannab vähem detaili kui lainekuju

label.en: It shifts upward until it exceeds the sampling rate
label.et: See nihkub ülespoole, kuni ületab diskreetimissageduse
